label: DISARM system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Defense Island System Associated with Restriction-Modification locus that uses methyltransferase-associated self/non-self discrimination and DrmAB activation to inhibit bacteriophage DNA replication.
exact_synonyms: Defense Island System Associated with Restriction-Modification|Defense Island System Associated with Restriction Modification
observations: Methyltransferase-associated antiphage branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual drm genes and proteins, DUF1998 proteins outside DISARM context, individual source rows naming one candidate DISARM locus, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, CBASS, abortive infection, and phosphorothioate defense.
